title: What would refute the workspace synthesis

statements.text: The workspace synthesis would be refuted if its key neural components were implausible or absent in primate cortex, or if late ignition were found to be unnecessary, artifactual, noncoding or not causally related to conscious states.

sources.locator: IV. Present Experimental and Theoretical Challenges
sources.quote: or if its predicted patterns of activity (the late “ignition”) were found to be unnecessary, artifactual, noncoding, or noncausally related to conscious states.
